vulnerability.name: USN-9179-1
vulnerability.description: Albert Yang and Quang Luong discovered that the Compiler component of CRaC JDK 21 did not correctly handle certain inputs. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2026-114938)  It was discovered that the JGSS component of CRaC JDK 21 did not correctly authenticate users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114939)  Nicholas Carlini discovered that the JSSE component of CRaC JDK 21 did not correctly authorize users.
